parts.name: tube body

physics.Basic_description: The main cylindrical body of the lipstick container, appearing white with a smooth matte plastic finish.
physics.Functional_description: Houses the internal twist mechanism and provides the primary structural base for the object.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical side surface firmly with parallel jaws to stabilize the object during manipulation.
physics.reason: Standard injection-molded cosmetic packaging uses thin walls to minimize material while maintaining shape.

parts.name: center band

physics.Basic_description: A thin green ring located at the junction between the cap and the base.
physics.Functional_description: Serves as a visual accent or indicates the separation line between the cap and the base.
physics.Grasped_description: Too narrow to grasp effectively; avoid gripping here to prevent slippage.
physics.reason: Likely a thin decorative ring or part of the molded shell structure.

annotationMapping.method: unique scaled centroid (source volume uses thinwall_solid_tetra)

parts.name: carrier cup

physics.Basic_description: Internal component visible as the rim or holder for the lipstick bullet, typically smooth plastic.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the lipstick wax securely and moves vertically via the twist mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal part, not accessible for grasping without disassembly.
physics.reason: Must be a cup-shaped shell to hold the wax bullet.

parts.description: Internal component visible as the rim or holder for the lipstick bullet, typically smooth plastic.
parts.function: Holds the lipstick wax securely and moves vertically via the twist mechanism.

parts.name: bullet red

physics.Basic_description: The red lipstick wax itself, shaped with a slanted tip, appearing soft and slightly glossy.
physics.Functional_description: The consumable cosmetic product applied to the lips.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; the material is soft, deformable, and would be damaged by gripper pressure.
physics.reason: Lipstick bullets are solid blocks of wax/pigment mixture.

physics.Functional_description: Visual indicator or manufacturing artifact on the internal mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to grasp.
physics.reason: Likely a small solid feature or paint mark on the carrier.

parts.name: cap shell

physics.Basic_description: The removable white cylindrical cover that fits over the lipstick bullet.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the lipstick wax from damage and drying out when not in use.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical side to remove or replace the cap.
physics.reason: Caps are hollow shells designed to fit over the base.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
